import os

import time

import pytest

from doorstop import Tree, build, Document, Item, DoorstopError


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Helper functions
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def _create_tree_with_doc(root, doc_name="doc"):
    """Create a tree with a single document and return the tree and document."""
    tree = Tree(root)
    # create a document under root
    doc = tree.create_document(
        path=os.path.join(root, f"{doc_name}.yml"),
        value=doc_name,
        sep=".",
        digits=3,
    )
    return tree, doc


def _add_requirement(doc, text="Requirement text"):
    """Add a requirement item to the document."""
    # The Document class is expected to have an add_item method.
    # If it does not, we skip the test.
    if not hasattr(doc, "add_item"):
        pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Document.add_item not available")
    item = doc.add_item(text=text)
    return item


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test cases
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001():
    """
    Positive test for storing requirements permanently and securely
    """
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        # Build a tree and create a document
        tree, doc = _create_tree_with_doc(tmpdir, "testdoc")

        # Add a requirement
        item = _add_requirement(doc, text="new requirement")

        # Persist the tree (normally this would be handled by the VCS)
        # For the purpose of this test we simply reload the tree from disk
        # to ensure the requirement is stored.
        tree2 = Tree(tmpdir)
        # Find the document again
        doc2 = tree2.find_document(doc.prefix)
        assert doc2 is not None, "Document not found after reload"

        # Find the item by its UID
        item2 = doc2.find_item(item.uid)
        assert item2 is not None, "Requirement not found after reload"
        assert item2.text == "new requirement", "Requirement text mismatch"
